scene: The buoyant lilypad drifts to an open transit dock overlooking three routes.
picture: Flat side view along a wet wooden dock. On the far left, a purple night bus idles with open doors. Left of centre, the player in yellow raincoat stands upon the docked green lilypad. Centre right floats a blue harbour ferry, and on the far right an orange cable car waits at a metal boarding pylon.
shown: a sleek purple night bus idling at a stop sign on the far left
a bobbing blue harbour ferry moored to the wooden dock at centre right
an orange cable car hanging open at its boarding tower on the far right

variants.scene: Your pad bumps the pier where three cozy rides wait in the rain.
